purpose: Test whether conditioning query-vector reward memory on the runtime-visible relation between the direct answer and the proposed evidence route can preserve v2 precision while increasing safe stopping coverage.

predecessor.measured_reason_for_successor: k=1 at cosine 0.95 saved 3 of 26 tuning contacts and 1 of 11 support contacts with zero harm, but the support fold required at least 2 stops; query geometry improved precision but lacked supported coverage

single_variable_change.changed: state representation: query-vector cosine memory is conditioned on the direct answer's rank class in the pre-contact fused evidence route
unchanged: locked v1 baseline and knowledge bytes
STOP requires unanimous non-positive observed acquisition return

scope.eligible: locked-v1 baseline-dispatched trajectories with both logged frozen-core responses

state.route_source: the direct answer's parsed scenario/action and the ordered fused task targets computed before an evidence response is requested

policy.decision: STOP only if the k highest-cosine utterance-group-independent memory neighbors have the same route class, all meet the minimum cosine, and all have observed ACQUIRE-minus-STOP primary return <= 0; otherwise ACQUIRE

exploratory_discovery.name: DEV-100-ROUND4
exploratory_discovery.exposure_status: all reward folds already exposed by v1 and v2; no fold is described as fresh support

holdout.name: DEV-500-NEW400
holdout.admission: only after a cross-fitted v3 policy artifact passes and is committed

exploratory_stability_screen.split: whole utterance groups, deterministic balanced assignment; each decision is evaluated only against memory from the other four folds
exploratory_stability_screen.candidate_admission: zero harmful STOP in aggregate, at least ceil(10 percent of all eligible decisions) STOP, and at least one STOP in at least three of five folds
exploratory_stability_screen.tie_break: maximum contacts saved, then larger k, then larger minimum cosine
exploratory_stability_screen.failure: write a failed artifact and keep NEW400 unread
exploratory_stability_screen.interpretation: adaptive exploratory stability only; not independent support

claim_boundary: A holdout pass would be a retrospective Stage-2 training-free control-plane contribution on already-exposed devel data. Cross-fitting alone cannot revise the baseline or support a superiority claim. No result is a test, confirmatory, generality, Stage-3, or paper claim.
